src_legend.obs: seen in a source: mapped in OSM, measured by us on Sentinel-2 / Umbra, or read in the AIP (mirror) (refs say which)
src_legend.inf: inferred: by a stated rule, from a rounded position, or a default

note: nose = the OSM stop node (end of the painted lead-in line as mapped), used as the nose tip of the class reference aircraft [inf]; hdg = final lead-in segment (true deg); cls = sfo3d class (B / C / CL / D / E / EL / F, js/live/airport.js CLASS_MAX) from our geometry + Sentinel-2 parked-aircraft evidence (cls_src 'obs' = a wide-body was fitted on >= 2 Sentinel-2 dates); span_max = the largest span that clears the neighbours at their class maxima (every stand); bridges[] from OSM gate nodes + the Umbra SAR scene 2024-06-02 (src 'obs' = SAR corridor signature above the p95 of a terminal-adjacent null; door-2 bridges inf); push = along the own lead-in to the first apron lane (inf); excl = stands not usable at the same time at full class; alt_group = alternative positions (overlapping fuselages). Stand names are OSM refs (ODbL); no per-stand AIP-derived field.
nose_note: nose = the OSM stop node, used as the nose tip of the class reference aircraft [inf]. At VDGS stands the stop position usually refers to the nose wheel or the pilot, a few metres behind the nose tip [inf, from memory]; the 10 m Sentinel-2 check (median 1 m) cannot settle it. A per-type nose offset is to be applied when the aircraft models are placed (Phase 2 / 4; QA C1 L6).

aip_facts.notice: AIP China AD 2 ZSSS (CAAC) via an unofficial mirror, EFF 2026-07-08; short cited facts; not covered by ODbL (the ODbL licence of this file does not apply to this block)

taxi_in_push_back.text: All stands are "Taxi in, Push back" (AD 2.20 3.2.6 column "Enter or Exit").

stand_count.text: 161 stand designators incl. 6 combined / alternative positions (AD 2.20 3.2.6, 3.2.7); no stand coordinates are published.

adjacent.text: Simultaneous operation of two aircraft at adjacent stands is forbidden (entry, push-out, or one in and one out) (AD 2.20 3.2.2.1).

stop_before_leadin.text: Arrival aircraft stop on the taxiway before turning onto the stand lead-in line, then enter slowly (AD 2.20 3.2.2.2).

marshaller.text: Stand-off (remote) and VIP stands: marshaller guidance; listed stands have a visual docking guidance system (AD 2.20 3.2.2.3).

follow_me_apron2.text: Follow-me guidance into the stands of apron Nr. 2 except 232-235, 262-265, 286-290 (AD 2.20 3.2.3).

push_l12_l13_l14.text: Stands 232-235 push back to a holding point on TWY L12, 262-265 on L13, 286-290 on L14, then start up and taxi to TWY D (AD 2.20 3.2.2.4 c-e).

push_4xx.text: Stands 401-416 (span < 65 m) push back to the holding point on TWY L11 (AD 2.20 3.2.2.4 g).

business.text: Business stands 310-312; business aircraft with span >= 31 m park on a stand meeting the span limit (AD 2.20 3.2.9).

apu_bridge.text: Aircraft on boarding-bridge stands must shut the APU and use bridge 400 Hz power and pre-conditioned air (AD 2.20 3.5.1).

push_rules.not_transcribed: the remaining AD 2.20 3.2.2.4-3.2.2.5 push-back / nose-direction rules and the end-of-push point table (AIP lists; local only, OD3)
